title: Privacy labels, data declarations, and the permission you have to justify

videos.script:
Both stores now put a privacy summary on the app's page. {{label}} Before somebody installs the planner, they can see what it collects and whether it is tied to them. You write that summary yourself, in a form.

The form asks about everything that leaves the phone. {{sdk}} Including what a crash reporter or an analytics library sends, code you did not write and may never have read.

So the honest answer starts with a list. {{inventory}} Today you keep the planner's data as a file, and a script turns it into the answers each store asks for.

Then the permissions. {{permission}} Every time the app asks for the camera or the calendar, it has to say why, in words a person reads. And on both stores, an app that lets people make an account must let them delete it.
